# Preserve the collector module and exported-function naming namespaces

This family uses the PascalCase file AddressCollector.sys.mjs with a lowerCamel exported function collectSingleAddress. The privileged resource module is registered in moz.build; it is not a class named AddressCollector. Preserve those local roles when adding a related helper. These source patterns do not establish a universal Thunderbird filename or function naming rule. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/compose/src.
